findings.issue_text: [Low/concurrency] `@loaded_locales` is lazily initialized and checked outside `LOAD_MUTEX`, allowing concurrent first calls to overwrite the tracking array or trigger duplicate locale loads
[Low/performance] `locale` is not normalized before checking `@loaded_locales`, so equivalent string and symbol values are tracked separately and reload the same translation files

goldens.comment: The @loaded_locales instance variable in translate_accelerator.rb is lazily initialized and accessed by multiple concurrent threads without synchronization.

Consider normalizing the input locale (e.g., to a symbol) when checking/loading here to avoid double-loading if the same locale is passed as a String vs Symbol (also applies to other locations in the PR).
